name: Interview with the Vampire: The Blood Hunter
source:
A young detective tries to get to the bottom of recent vampiric murders in New Orleans, only to find himself 'interviewing' the culprit.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
一名年轻侦探试图查清新奥尔良近来发生的几起吸血鬼谋杀案，到头来却发现自己正在“采访”凶手本人。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]］
